global_limits: G25 typed direct uc_bounds Span is the predeclared semantic exception; no general unwrap credit.
G11 missing required R7 verdicts qualify, not generic certificate failure or finalCeiling.
D4u is assertion-preserving current reconstruction; prior overflow controls intact.
Stopped refusal and successful refusal-count checks do not qualify optional cached non-budget path.
Runtime work/count values are observations of fixed equality/monotonicity predicates, not new absolute expected tables.
